name: proto-transport-reads-nothing
description: Generated transport reads nothing: a request sent through a gRPC client, a Connect client or a Connect-ES client is encoded by the runtime, so its fields stay unreferenced, while the client method each call selects is a live consumer of the RPC.
pending: bindings.13: deadset-go and deadset-ts do not follow generated transport or a hand site passing a message to an RPC runtime (GO5, J7).
